headline: 普尔特获指定代理国家情报总监
summary: 特朗普于2026年6月2日宣布指定普尔特代理国家情报总监，白宫6月4日公告确认任命。普尔特6月19日接任，同时保留FHFA局长职务；8月3日向克莱顿交接。

sources.title: Strong Support for President Trump’s Appointment of William J. Pulte as Acting Director of National Intelligence
sources.excerpt: appointment of William J. Pulte to serve as Acting Director of National Intelligence

sources.title: Reed: Trump’s Cynical Pick for Acting Top Spy Chief is Dangerously Unqualified
sources.excerpt: Today, after President Donald Trump tapped Bill Pulte

sources.title: Bill Pulte assumes role of US acting director of national intelligence
sources.excerpt: Bill Pulte, the Federal Housing Finance Agency director, became the acting director of national intelligence (DNI) on Friday
sources.note: 报道发于 2026 年 6 月 19 日（周五）

sources.title: Jay Clayton Sworn In As Director Of National Intelligence
sources.excerpt: Today, Jay Clayton was sworn in as the nation’s ninth Director of National Intelligence
sources.note: 克莱顿当日宣誓就任国家情报总监，普尔特代理随之结束
